description: The spoken text of a reply together with the language its phrases were chosen for, which the caller hands to speak(_:voiceID:rate:language:) so the voice can never disagree with the phrases (spec #100 slice 2.5, ticket #160). The language is decided ONCE, on the input after fences became U+FFFC and before any other rule (so a link's URL still counts), as the lowercased primary subtag of dominantLanguageCode(of:) or "en" when that is undecided. Only zh gets localized phrases (（代码已省略）, ……回复已截断。 joined with no space); every other language, ja and ko included, gets the English ones. The text rules are those of speech-text.json.
